summary: HWH International Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 Stock Purchase Agreement with majority stockholder Smart Dynamics Technology Limited to acquire all shares of BVI-incorporated Hearty Nova Limited for $1.00. Hearty Nova holds 51% of Hong Kong JV China Gas Africa Clean Energy Investment Holdings Limited, alongside 49% holder China Gas Holdings. The JV targets a Nigerian natural gas processing plant, with HWH anticipating roughly $1,173,000 funding and CGH $1,127,000. The board also approved renaming to EnerSyn Global Inc. Heavy related-party overlap warrants scrutiny.
